snippet.title: Sort Labs Trailer
snippet.description: Sort Labs is a casual first-person organization experiment: restore order to the laboratory full of geometric shapes and objects. Pick up and place each shape on the right shelf sorted by color and size. With customizable stages and multiple levels of difficulty, the experiments never end!
